data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nasala', meaning 'to deliver', 'to give'. In Islamic spirituality, the name Nasila represents the gentle, tender, and loving nature of Allah towards His creation. The name Nasila carries the meaning “Delicate, tender, sweet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasila usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
